10.10.10.49:
set -eu
cd /tmp/honk-rule-check.1S1KHu
export HONK_ROUTING_TEST_OBJECT="$PWD/routing-test.o"
export DAE_LOCATION_ASSET="$PWD"
unset HTTP_PROXY HTTPS_PROXY ALL_PROXY http_proxy https_proxy all_proxy
finish() {
    result=$?
    trap - EXIT
    pgrep -a honk-core > processes-after.log || test "$?" -eq 1
    printf 'HOST_TEST_EXIT=%s\n' "$result"
    exit "$result"
}
trap finish EXIT
timeout 600 ./honk-config-tests --test-threads=1 --nocapture > config-tests.log 2>&1
printf '%s\n' CONFIG_TESTS_PASS
timeout 600 ./honk-core-tests routing:: --test-threads=1 --nocapture > routing-tests.log 2>&1
printf '%s\n' ROUTING_TESTS_PASS
timeout 600 ./honk-core-tests control::routing_matcher --test-threads=1 --nocapture > compiler-tests.log 2>&1
printf '%s\n' COMPILER_TESTS_PASS
timeout 600 ./honk-core-tests ebpf::real::routing::tests --ignored --test-threads=1 --nocapture > kernel-routing-tests.log 2>&1
printf '%s\n' KERNEL_ROUTING_TESTS_PASS ALL_RULE_TESTS_PASS
